title: Chapter 905
paragraphs: Chapter 905
Episode 228. Battle at Grosche Castle (1)

After Zipple and Kinzelo each deployed their fleets towards Grosche Castle, the Vamel Alliance had been continuously in meetings, awaiting news. News that their fleets had really started attacking Grosche Castle.
Though the chance was low, if their fleets were defeated on the way, their plan would go awry.

{Master, we have received communication from the Golden Fleet. Zipple's fleet has begun attacking the rearguard defense line of Grosche Castle, and Kinzelo's fleet just arrived and is positioning itself against the castle's left defense line. Once again, the situation is unfolding just as you predicted, Master.}
"Understood, Captain Kasimir. Please inform them we will deploy shortly."
{Yes, Master. Best of luck.}
Now that the battle had begun, neither Zipple nor Kinzelo would back out. With a smile, Jin put down the communicator.

"Zipple is in the rear, and Kinzelo is on the left. In that case, we should breakthrough by pressing the front defense line that we had been facing from the start. And naturally, the right defense line will probably end up being managed by both us and Zipple."

[Zipple is probably expecting the same, Commander. Since our objectives align, even if our battle lines intermingle, it won't turn into a three-way conflict, but we will inevitably need to keep each other in check, so the battle on the right defense line will likely be the most protracted.]
"That's what I think as well. Penetrating the defense line and entering the castle will likely start from either the front, rear, or left."
"Heh, a competition, eh? I don't want to lose, kiddo."

"Same here. Normally, it would be more strategic to carefully observe the situation and wait for the others to break through the defense line first... but this time, we'll be the first to break through. Even if Zipple and Kinzelo hold back, we won't."
"Oh, what's gotten into you? So, you're saying we should go out there and smash them all up without wasting time measuring? I like it."
Murakan was in agreement, but Leuth showed a look of surprise.
Of course, she would. This assault was essentially started by three hostile factions working together to eliminate a common enemy, so there was no particular need for us to lead the charge.
[Commander, may I ask the reason behind your decision?]
"We need to leave a record in this world that Grosche Castle was toppled and ultimately the Demon World was smashed not by anyone else, but by the Vamel Alliance."
Leuth's eyes widened.
[You want to etch into everyone in the world that we were the ones who saved the world from the underworld.]
Of course, if humanity wins the Demon War, everyone will inevitably know that the large powers fought together.
However, the most glorious achievement could ultimately only go to one force. Piercing the Grosh Fortress, defeating the Ben force.
Jin believed that it should be the share of the Vamel Alliance, just as it was in the previous Demon God War.

After all, the Vamel Alliance was the only one struggling for 'life' without other goals such as the purification of the world due to the resurrection of the sun god or total control through the completion of the magic stone.
Jin did not want to pass the honor to Zipple and Kinzelo. They did not deserve it.

"Also, there is a situation where we don't know when Zipple's magic stone will suddenly strengthen. As more people know that we are fighting for the world, I wonder if the names of everyone here, including me, will become more clearly associated with the power of our existence. It might be a vain hope, but..."
[No, it's not a vain hope, it will become a reality. You're right, we should take the greatest credit.]

"I have a feeling that Veradin might also be conscious of this. If people think that Zipple was at the center of defeating the underground forces, it could make it easier for him to manipulate history later on."
Jin got up and took his sword.
"Let's go, Murakan."

In the ongoing meeting, it was decided that only Jin and Murakan would join the barrier as the first sortie. It was agreed to send forces according to the response of the demon world after the two of them began the breakthrough.
Those who were sitting got up and saluted Jin.
[Be careful, lord. I will communicate with the Golden Fleet again and tell them that you will arrive at the front line within 5 minutes.]
"See you on the battlefield in an hour, young one. It'll be the first time you'll see the Lord of the Archer fight since training with me, right? You'll be surprised."
"We will also join the barrier as soon as the additional rift is confirmed not to occur."
Jin and Murakan stepped out into the garden.
"Murakan, unlike last time, we're not just checking Grosh Fortress and pulling out, so run wild."
"Hehe, just as I hoped, kiddo. My body has been itching since I recovered."
The Red Owl quickly took them to the front line of Grosh Fortress.
"Are you okay? It's unusual that you didn't vomit. Are you getting used to it?"
Just as Murakan was about to answer that he barely held on, a substantial shock was suddenly transmitted, shaking the inside of the ship.
Some of the indiscriminate shelling and magic from the demon world side aimed at the barrier had hit the Red Owl.
"Damn, what luck. We were in the middle of becoming invisible so aiming was impossible, yet they hit the hull directly. But the shield developed by Dr. Qwaul is quite something......"
"Ugh, bleeeh!"
Regrettably, Murakan had no choice but to empty his stomach all at once, and due to the violent shaking of the ship, vomit splattered everywhere.

Jin demonstrated higher concentration than ever and dodged the vomit with agility. Fortunately, an unfortunate incident of the Guardian Dragon's vomit staining his coat before the enemy's blood did not occur.
Usually, in such a case, one might feel that it's not off to a good start.
But when Jin briefly examined Murakan's expression, it was actually a blessing in disguise.
'He's pissed, he's really pissed.'
Murakan was furious. He was about to overcome the nausea from space-jumping for the first time in his life, but the enemy's attack ruined it.
"Haha, hahahaha! You bastards. How did I endure this...... It's all messed up, really."
As the Red Owl's invisibility was deactivated, the attacks from the demon world side, which had been wildly firing, abruptly ceased.
"A space-jumping small ship...... It's Jin Runcandel......!"
"Jin Runcandel has intruded! All forces, aim at the small ship!"
Boom-!
A white flare shot up from the Red Owl. It was a signal flare to notify the allies in the barrier that Jin and Murakan had arrived.
"The leader has come!"
[Our leader has arrived! Qwaul, order the entire army. Open the gates to the maximum and just ram them all in!]

"Hey, that, that! If it's at that position, even if it's invisible, the Red Owl could be hit! I have to fix that too! Damn it, first, all ships get in! While the enemies are aiming at the leader, we will stick all our bullets and magic into their hearts!"
Unlike the demon world, the Vamel Alliance increased their attack, completely disregarding the possibility of Jin getting hit. It was a pre-agreed strategy.

Of course, concentrating all their firepower on the Red Owl turned out to be a mistake for the demon world. They did not think they could catch Jin with shelling, they just desperately wanted to destroy the Red Owl, so it wasn't necessarily a wrong decision.
Soon, Jin and Murakan dashed out, and the Red Owl immediately started continuous space jumps to preset coordinates.
Once to the side of the original point where the space jump ended, once forward, and once to the center of the demon world's front defense line.....
In this way, the Red Owl made a final space jump to Tikan, confusing the enemies for about 10 seconds.
Shaking the balance of the ongoing long-range artillery battle, led by the golden ships, was an easy task in those 10 seconds.
That's because Jin and Murakan weren't just standing still.
The two skillfully avoided the dense gunfire and magic from their allies in the sky, and were destroying the flagship of Jinmagye, which was at the very front of the defensive line.

Jin wasn't using any decisive weapon or magic sword, but simply slashed through Jinmagye's flagship and forces with the energy put into his sword. Murakan, transformed into his true form, was irritably thrashing around with his front paws, tail, and wings. Of course, every time he moved his gigantic body, the enemy forces, various defense devices, and ships were swept away like fallen leaves.
Buzz, Crack, Zzz!
The two looked like giants intruding into a swarm of ants. Every minor movement worked as a fatal blow to the demons on the defensive line.
"Lord Kraps! The Demon Lords and generals must step in. Ordinary soldiers can't handle this."
Kraps, the general called out, couldn't hear his subordinate's pleading to the end. As he turned around, a sudden, dark darkness swallowed his subordinate.
It was Murakan's spiritual energy. The black pillars, huge as the pillars of a great temple, were piercing through everywhere.
'I, I need to ask for support from Lord Sakiel...!'
Kaang, Shiiiiiiiiiiiiiii...!

Following his subordinate, Kraps was also engulfed in darkness before he could finish his thought. All the demons aboard Kraps' ship disappeared like that. The same was true for other ships floating next to them.

"Demon scum of Jinmagye, you will have to pay for angering this Murakan. How dare you interrupt the historic moment of mine... Have you all lost your minds in faith in Zito, how did you see this Murakan!"
The demons who heard Murakan's voice wanted to ask what we interrupted, but they all had to face death before they could open their mouths.
The two, in no time, annihilated the leading forces of the defense line and were pointing their swords and black chains at the Demon Lords stationed behind them.
"From here on, I see some guys who look like Demon Lords mixed in. Were they using weaker guys as shields? Or did they lose their tension in the long-standing battle."
Huhruck...!
Blazing fire wrapped around Bradamante.
"Either way, now that you've met me, you're going to become a handful of ashes. Know that it's an honor to die by this sword. It will be quite a painful death......"

As Jin spread the magic sword skill Uphwa, the Demon Lords hurriedly pulled out the flesh of Zito from their bosoms. But the flames of Uphwa did not even give them a moment to break and absorb that flesh, they were just invading.
In the fierce fire that covered the whole sky, the demons had no choice but to anticipate death.
